dialog.title: Accounts
dialog.description: Argo reads Tickets through these Accounts. Each GitHub or Linear identity is its own Account.

notice.label: Sign-in notice
notice.title: Connect your Accounts again
notice.body: Sign-ins from the earlier Argo app do not carry over.

row.label: {{provider}} Account {{login}}
row.noConnections: No Project reads Tickets through this Account.

note.expired: The sign-in expired and {{provider}} would not renew it. Reconnect to read Tickets again.
note.revoked: {{provider}} no longer accepts this sign-in. Reconnect to read Tickets again.
note.unreadable: Argo cannot open the stored sign-in on this computer. Reconnect to read Tickets again.

confirm.github_one: Disconnect {{login}}? Its repository stops reading Tickets until you connect it again.
confirm.github_other: Disconnect {{login}}? Its {{count}} repositories stop reading Tickets until you connect it again.
confirm.linear_one: Disconnect {{login}}? Its team stops reading Tickets until you connect it again.
confirm.linear_other: Disconnect {{login}}? Its {{count}} teams stop reading Tickets until you connect it again.

github.name: GitHub
github.challenge: Enter this code on GitHub to connect an Account.

linear.name: Linear
linear.challenge: Allow Argo in the Linear page your browser opened to connect an Account.

error.access-denied: Argo cannot manage Accounts for this window.
error.unsupported-version: This Account contract version is not supported.
error.invalid-response: Argo received an invalid Account response.
error.connection-lost: The connection to Argo was lost.
error.secure-storage-unavailable: This computer cannot store a sign-in securely.
error.provider-unavailable: This build of Argo cannot sign in to that service.
error.rate-limited: GitHub is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
error.linear-rate-limited: Linear is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
error.sign-in-port-busy: Another app is using the port Linear signs in through. Close it and try again.
error.sign-in-expired: The sign-in expired before it was finished. Start again.
error.storage-invalid: The Account store cannot be read in this format.
error.storage-unavailable: Argo cannot access the Account store.
error.storage-not-written: Argo could not save the Account.
